question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

**None of the option** seems appropriate.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "**None of the option seems appropriate**" in the sentence is incorrect and lacks grammatical agreement.
 
• "None of the options" is the grammatically correct form because the word "**options**" is plural, and "**None**" aligns with plural nouns.
 
• Thus, "**Option 4**" provides the correct replacement for the bold part of the sentence.
 
• This correction ensures clarity and proper grammatical structure in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"None of the options seems appropriate."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Any of the optionals" **– This option is incorrect because "optionals" is not a valid term in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "No optionals" **– This option is incorrect because "optionals" is not grammatically appropriate.
 
• **Option 3: "No one of the" **– This option is incorrect because it is an awkward and ungrammatical phrase.
